title: 逐模型波形误差 / Waveform error by model
alt_text: Four panels compare every method for each model in Main and LowerSNR, separately for Direct and Split. Points are finite-row means, vertical lines span the empirical 10th–90th percentiles. Numerical failures with finite scores remain included; nonfinite counts are explicit.

title: 相对Frozen的全部配对差 / All paired changes versus Frozen
alt_text: Individual paired percentage changes are shown as faint points and each model mean as a larger symbol. Zero means equality with the same-route Frozen. Every paired finite score is included, with unresolved counts disclosed.

title: Direct局部保幅代价 / Local amplitude costs (Direct)
alt_text: Six panels display paired absolute changes in event amplitude, weak-event, pinchout-tail, AVO intercept, AVO gradient and fault-neighborhood errors. Small circles show model means, larger method symbols show the equal-model average. Missing and inapplicable entries are counted together and retained in source data.

title: Split局部保幅代价 / Local amplitude costs (Split)
alt_text: Six panels display paired absolute changes in event amplitude, weak-event, pinchout-tail, AVO intercept, AVO gradient and fault-neighborhood errors. Small circles show model means, larger method symbols show the equal-model average. Missing and inapplicable entries are counted together and retained in source data.

title: 不隐藏失败 / Failures retained in the full denominator
alt_text: Two stacked bar charts classify every row from every suite as numerical/invalid, a valid waveform error above one, or a valid error at most one. Numbers above bars give all-row denominators; nonfinite errors remain in the invalid category.

title: 全部分布及完整最差尾部 / Full distributions including the worst tail
alt_text: Empirical cumulative curves include every finite RelativeError, regardless of solver status, across all suites. Their denominator includes nonfinite rows, so an incomplete curve can end below one. The full observed error range is shown and the error=1 threshold is marked.

title: 压力情景与最差案例 / Stress suites and worst cases
alt_text: The left heatmap contains mean paired percentage changes for Combined Split versus Frozen Split in every stress suite and model, with symmetric full-range colors and gray missing cells. The right table names the worst finite error for every method across all rows and routes. Nonfinite failures are reported separately rather than omitted from the study.

title: 指定道集 / Predesignated gather: Main / SmoothAVO
alt_text: Five same-gather panels show truth, observation, Frozen Split and Combined Direct/Split for the predesignated first model/calibration/observation. Every panel uses the same symmetric amplitude range, set by the largest absolute value across all shown arrays, so no sample is clipped.

title: 指定道集 / Predesignated gather: LowerSNR / SmoothAVO
alt_text: Five same-gather panels show truth, observation, Frozen Split and Combined Direct/Split for the predesignated first model/calibration/observation. Every panel uses the same symmetric amplitude range, set by the largest absolute value across all shown arrays, so no sample is clipped.

title: 指定道集 / Predesignated gather: StressSourceShape / SmoothAVO
alt_text: The predesignated example was not saved. This placeholder records the missing artifact without selecting an alternative result.

title: 固定1/6/11道 / Fixed traces 1/6/11: waveform and spectrum
alt_text: Three fixed traces, 1, 6 and 11, are shown with their full time waveforms and unsmoothed Fourier magnitudes over the full Nyquist range. Truth, observed data, Frozen Split and both Combined routes retain raw amplitude scaling and distinct line styles.

title: 弱反射与尖灭局部 / Predesignated weak-event and pinchout zooms
alt_text: Two rows compare truth, Frozen Split and Combined Split for the predesignated weak-event and pinchout examples. The time window is fixed at 0.45–0.85 seconds; pinchout uses fixed tail traces 9–11. Each row shares its full absolute amplitude maximum across shown methods, with no clipping.

title: 实际最差候选案例 / Actual worst candidate case: 道集 / gather
alt_text: The actual largest finite RelativeError among the three declared candidate Split branches is shown beside its same-observation Frozen Split, truth and observation. Selection uses maximum error, including finite solver-failed results, with deterministic tie breaks; it does not choose an attractive example. The key, status and errors are printed. All panels share an unclipped absolute amplitude maximum.

title: 实际最差候选案例 / Actual worst candidate case: 波形与频谱 / waveform and spectrum
alt_text: For the same actual worst finite candidate Split case, fixed traces 1, 6 and 11 show the full-time raw waveforms and unsmoothed full-Nyquist spectra of truth, observation, the candidate and its matched Frozen Split. The case identifiers, solver status and candidate/Frozen errors are printed. Trace choice is fixed rather than selected by the appearance of failure.
